text:
Maya: Draft of the product launch post is up — https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft (please use preview link). Need a quick round of approvals: messaging, bench callouts, webinar blurb, and inbound lead routing. Target publish Tue 10am PT.
Ethan: Skimmed — overall great. Can we add one sentence calling out the latency improvement numbers (p50/p99) in the second section?
Maya: Yep — will add p50/p99 numbers from the latest bench this afternoon.
Priya: Can you paste the CTA / HubSpot mapping here? I need it to wire the landing form and workflows.
Maya: Pasting mapping below: ```utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=april_launch
hubspot_form_id=9876
cta_primary=Register for webinar -> form:hubspot:9876:field=attend
cta_secondary=Request demo -> form:hubspot:1234:field=demo_request
lead_tags=launch_apr,benchmark_interest
```
Daniel: Hero image ready — sent to the preview. Need alt text and two CRO variants for the CTA (Attend / Request demo).
Sam: Alt text suggestion: "Redwood Inference dashboard showing low-latency token throughput" — ok?
Daniel: Good enough, use that. I also uploaded a mobile crop.
Lena (Legal): Quick pass requested — high-level: remove absolute superlatives like "the fastest". Replace with "industry-leading" or quantifiable claims. Also confirm we don’t call out any third-party model names as endorsements.
Maya: Done — replaced "the fastest" with "industry-leading" and removed vendor model references.
Ethan: Webinar blurb looks fine. Recommend two CTAs on the hero: "Join the webinar" and "Request a demo". Keep hero CTAs primary/secondary for tracking.
Priya: Routing plan: webinar attendees -> nurture track "launch_webinar_attend"; demo requests -> SDR queue with tag "product-launch-apr"; benchmarks opt-ins -> product-ml list. I'll add workflows in HubSpot after final mapping.
ops-bot: Preview site deployed: https://preview.redwood.ai/launch-apr (build #412).
Maya: QA checklist I'm tracking: links (preview), SEO meta, image alt, CTAs wired, HubSpot forms, lead routing, legal quick-pass, webinar registration flow. Anything else?
Daniel: SEO meta missing — can someone draft meta description (<=155 chars)?
Priya: Draft meta: "Redwood Inference launches a unified platform to lower latency and cost for production LLMs. See benchmarks and join the webinar."
Ethan: That reads well. Approved from product side.
Lena (Legal): Legal quick-pass: approved with the edits we discussed.
Maya: Thanks all — I updated the draft with p50/p99 bench numbers and CTA wiring. Scheduling: target Tue 10am PT. @ops-bot can you schedule the publish and trigger the announce slack message?
ops-bot: Scheduled: 2026-04-28T17:00:00Z. Announcement job queued to #general and #product.
Ethan: :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll follow up on the HubSpot workflows once scheduled.
Maya: Great — closing this thread unless any last-minute blockers. If you see anything in the preview, drop a single-line note here. Thanks!
